evidence:
tests/_topology_template.py:92-103: `if completed.returncode == 0:
    return completed.stdout
 if (repo / "HEAD").is_file() and (repo / "objects").is_dir():

Named violating input: a template whose repo has an absolute-path local remote pointing at a bare sibling (`origin.git`), copied with GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL setting safe.bareRepository=explicit — `_local_sibling_rewrites` -> `_refs_signature` -> `_git_output(source_remote, 'for-each-ref', ...)` must fall through to the `--git-dir` retry. No test sets safe.bareRepository=explicit while calling clone_topology_template / _git_output.

ABSENCE: test_bare_repository_fixture_portability_heldout.py::test_git_refuses_bare_discovery_but_accepts_an_explicit_git_dir pins the git behavior in isolation (line 400-436) but never routes through _git_output; the clone_topology_template callers (test_topology_template_upkeep_guard.py, test_concurrency_regression.py fixtures) run under the default bare-repository policy, so returncode==0 on the first call and the retry never executes.
advisory.finding: The new bare-repository `--git-dir` retry branch in `_git_output` (added lines 94-102) is not exercised by any test: reaching it requires `git -C <bare>` to fail (safe.bareRepository=explicit), but under the default CI posture (safe.bareRepository=all) the first `git -C` call succeeds and returncode==0, so the fallback is dead on CI. The change's stated purpose — rewriting copied topologies' local origins under strict bare-repository policy — has no regression test that drives the added code.
advisory.suggested_fix: In an integration test, build a template repo whose `origin` remote is an absolute path to a bare `origin.git` sibling, set GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL/GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM with safe.bareRepository=explicit (as test_bare_repository_fixture_portability_heldout already does), call clone_topology_template, and assert the copied repo's origin was rewritten to the copied sibling — asserting a non-None _refs_signature/for-each-ref result to prove the --git-dir fallback ran rather than returning None.
